purpose: We develop a survival analysis of stroke patients. Aggregated statistics cannot capture individual time-to-event data, so pseudonymised records are needed.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions and encounters for adults with a stroke.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Stroke = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I63.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
